name: fourteen days cross a weekend and Independence Day

steps.text: The trigger day 2026-07-02 is excluded. Counting starts 2026-07-03.

Counted 14 calendar days, including intermediate Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays, through 2026-07-16. Those days include 2026-07-03 (Independence Day, observed), 2026-07-04 (Saturday), 2026-07-05 (Sunday), 2026-07-11 (Saturday) and 2026-07-12 (Sunday).
The last day 2026-07-16 is a weekday and not a legal holiday, so it is included.
A legal holiday is a day set aside by FRCP 6(a)(6)(A) or 5 U.S.C. § 6103, including Juneteenth. When that day falls on a Saturday it is observed on Friday, and on a Sunday it is observed on Monday.

name: one day from the day before an observed holiday rolls to Monday

steps.text: The trigger day 2026-07-02 is excluded. Counting starts 2026-07-03.
Counted 1 calendar day, including intermediate Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays, through 2026-07-03.
The last day cannot be 2026-07-03, a legal holiday (Independence Day, observed); 2026-07-04, a Saturday; 2026-07-05, a Sunday. The period continues to 2026-07-06.
A legal holiday is a day set aside by FRCP 6(a)(6)(A) or 5 U.S.C. § 6103, including Juneteenth. When that day falls on a Saturday it is observed on Friday, and on a Sunday it is observed on Monday.

name: notice of intention to defend crosses a weekend and two public holidays

steps.text: The day of the trigger 2026-04-24 is not counted. 10 court days run after it.

A court day is not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday. Weekends skipped: 2026-04-25, 2026-04-26, 2026-05-02, 2026-05-03, 2026-05-09 and 2026-05-10. Public holidays skipped: 2026-04-27 (Freedom Day) and 2026-05-01 (Workers' Day). The last court day is 2026-05-12.
A public holiday is not a court day. When a public holiday falls on a Sunday, the following Monday is also a public holiday.
The days from 16 December to 15 January, both inclusive, are not counted in the time this rule allows. None of those days fell in this period.
